issue.message: D10: "Fills in Title (FD15)." names nothing the scope and the flows have. A step names what a flow gives the user there; drop what no flow has.

entries.reason: Changed D10 steps to name the task's Title so it names the Task noun from the scope.

issue.message: Sign-up conflict F02.A03 has no place: S02 never says the email already has an account. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the email already has an account' that reads the quoted message and offers to go to /sign-in.

entries.reason: Added alternative when the email already has an account with quoted message and link to /sign-in.

issue.message: Sign-in denied F03.A03 has no place: S03 never says no account matches. Fix: Add an alternative 'when no account matches' that reads the quoted message and offers to try again or go to /sign-up.

entries.reason: Added alternative when no account matches with quoted message and options to try again or go to /sign-up.

issue.message: Follow-up gone F14.A02 and F15.A02 have no place on the client list. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the note is no longer there' that reads that the note is gone and shows the client list as it is.

entries.reason: Added alternative when the note is no longer there that reads the note is gone and shows the client list.

issue.message: Tick-done gone F24.A02 has no place on the project page. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the task was deleted' for the tick action that reads that the task is gone and shows the remaining tasks.

entries.reason: Added alternative when the task was deleted for the tick action that reads the task is gone and shows remaining tasks.

issue.message: Public frame navigation holds only one destination. Fix: Remove 'from the navigation' for Book a session and let the logo and screens' actions provide it, or add a second navigation destination.

entries.reason: Removed 'from the navigation' wording so the single Book a session link is a frame action, not a one-item navigation.

issue.message: S05, S07, S08 and S10 put Add, Search and filters before what the user came for. Fix: Move the client/project/task/session-type list to the first steps and put Add, Search and filters after it; apply the same order on S07, S08 and S10.

entries.reason: Moved the client, project, task and session-type lists before Add, Search and filters on S05, S07, S08 and S10.

issue.message: Sign in and Book a session appear in both the public frame and the landing screen. Fix: Keep 'Sign in' only in FR01 and 'Book a session' only in FR01, removing the duplicate choices from S01 so each action appears once per view.

entries.reason: Removed Sign in and Book a session choices from S01 so each appears only in FR01 per view.

issue.message: Availability empty state is paraphrased instead of quoted. Fix: Quote the empty-availability words, as in Reads "No days set yet. No slots are offered until hours are set."

entries.reason: Quoted the empty-availability words as Reads "No days set yet. No slots are offered until hours are set."
